answer_1.quote: In this paper, we propose a novel learning approach ... to improve the faithfulness of knowledge‑grounded dialogue systems ... We conduct experiments on two knowledge‑grounded dialogue datasets: Wizard of Wikipedia (WoW) and FaithDial.

answer_2.quote: We use BLEU, ROUGE to evaluate the fluency of the generated responses ... We also report BERTScore, F1, Q2 F1 and Q2 NLI as faithfulness metrics.

answer_4.quote: We randomly select 100 dialogues from the test set of FaithDial and ask three human evaluators to evaluate. We ask the human evaluators to rate the fluency (Fluency), informativeness (Inform.) and faithfulness (Faithful.) of the generated responses on a 5‑point scale.
answer_4.guideline: Rate each generated response on fluency, informativeness, and faithfulness using a 5‑point Likert scale (1 = unacceptable, 3 = moderate, 5 = perfect).
